newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 154-day T-bills tranche yields 33.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 154-day T-bills tranche yields 33.98 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on a new tranche of 154-day GKO discount Treasury bills maturing June 11 was 33.98 percent at Wednesday's auction, the central bank said.
The previous tranche of the same issue yielded 33.01 percent at Tuesday's closing on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange.
Yield at the January 8 auction of the paper was 36.77 percent.
Issue volume 7.00 trln rbls 4.0 trln rbls
The new bills are subject to the existing tax regime, which frees income from government securities from tax.

President Boris Yeltsin signed a law earlier this month imposing a 15 percent tax on income from government securities but it has not yet come into force. Securities issued before the tax comes into effect will not be taxable.
The Finance Ministry is also selling a new 637-day 3.00 trillion rouble tranche of OFZ government bonds on January 22.
The ministry also repays 6.00 trillion roubles in maturing three-month T-bills (series 21071) and pays quarterly interest of about 229 billion roubles on the series 24009 bonds.
